question:
**Direction: Select the word that means the same as the group of words underlined in the given sentence.**

Vatsal is a **__lover and collector of books__**.
solution: The correct answer is** "bibliophile."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **'bibliophile'** means a person who loves and collects books. (वह व्यक्ति जो पुस्तकों का संग्रह करता हो या जिसे पुस्तकों से बहुत प्रेम हो) • The root word** 'biblio' **means book, and** 'phile'** means lover of. • It is a noun and can be used to describe someone's hobby or interest. • **Example**: *My friend is a **bibliophile**__ and has a huge collection of rare books.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1) anglophile** means a person who loves or admires England or the English. (एक व्यक्ति जो इंग्लैंड या अंग्रेजी से प्यार करता है या उसकी प्रशंसा करता है) • **Option 2) recluse** means a person who lives a solitary or secluded life. (वह व्यक्ति जो एकांत जीवन जीता है) • **Option 4) polyglot** means a person who knows and speaks many languages. (एक व्यक्ति जो कई भाषाएँ जानता और बोलता है) 3d:Tea7, The correct answer is** "Green-eyed."**
